name: Ashoro (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ashoro town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom beneath a pair of upswept wings.
history: Municipal flag of Ashoro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1965.

features.role: Ashoro town emblem — a ring open at the bottom beneath a pair of upswept wings
